Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme is ready to move into procurement. Our legal team asked me to collect a few items so we can scope the DPA and run the security review:

- Our main asks: a copy of Redwood's standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and a current list of subprocessors (ideally with locations and whether they process EU data).
- We need to confirm whether Redwood will accept the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for cross-border transfers or if you provide an alternative transfer mechanism (e.g., UK addendum, Binding Corporate Rules).
- Are you able to support customer-managed keys (BYOK/KMS) for hosted accounts, or is that only for Private deployments?
- Preferred e-sign method: DocuSign or AdobeSign? Procurement prefers DocuSign but can do AdobeSign if necessary.

I attached a short vendor questionnaire for the privacy/security team (customer_questionnaire.pdf). Can you loop in legal and let me know approximate turnaround for a DPA + subprocessors list? We hope to sign before the end of next week.

Hi Laura — Marissa on Legal here. Thanks for the clear list of questions — below are responses and next steps.

1) Subprocessors: the attached CSV is our live register. To answer specifically:
   - EU production processing: Dataflow Hub (EU nodes via GCP eu-west1), ModelCache EU edge nodes (operated by Redwood in region), and our EU telemetry cluster (logs/metrics).
   - Global control plane / logging: we use Redlake Analytics (US-hosted) for aggregated analytics and a managed logging provider (third-party) for operational logs — both are listed in the CSV with processing purposes and locations. If you need a vendor-by-vendor security brief ( SOC 2 overview / encryption-at-rest details ), we can provide that under NDA.

2) SCCs / Transfers: we accept the EU SCCs and can pair them with our DPA. We also maintain a UK transfer addendum; if Acme requires it we will include it. We do not use Binding Corporate Rules.

3) BYOK / KMS: BYOK is supported for Redwood Private deployments only. For Hosted accounts, keys are managed by our cloud provider; we can add contractual commitments about key handling and will provide crypto proofs (where applicable). If Acme requires BYOK, we can outline the Private deployment onboarding: estimated timeline 6–8 weeks, implementation fee TBD (depends on scale and support level). I can have a solutions engineer share a short SOW template if you want.

4) Redlines / Execution: we are happy to accept limited commercial and data retention redlines submitted as a tracked Word document. Material changes to indemnity or liability caps will need business approval (we're typically flexible on retention, audit windows, and reasonable SLA language). Please submit redlines and we will return a marked-up version within 3 business days where possible.

5) DocuSign: fine — we can prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature. Please confirm the signer (name/email) and whether sign-off from both legal and procurement will be required on your side.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura, please send any initial redlines as a tracked doc (attach to this thread).
- I’ve uploaded a short DPA redline guide and example responses to a shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Acme/DPA-redlines (attached guide: dpa_redline_guide.pdf).

Attachments: dpa_redline_guide.pdf (PDF, 86KB)

Best,
